text:
Type: stepped pine storage frame
Use: holding storage bins and toys, low shelving; children's room, playroom
Style: Scandinavian, rustic
Materials: solid pine in a clear natural finish, grooved rails for sliding bins
Colors: light natural pine
Shape: three-tier stepped shelving unit rising from low to tall, open compartments with grooved side rails for pull-out boxes, flat tops at each level, sturdy, medium visual weight
Feel: practical, warm, friendly
Goes with: colorful or white storage boxes, light wood, white walls; Scandinavian kids' rooms and playrooms

product.name: TROFAST
product.description: A playful and sturdy storage series for storing and organising toys, sitting, playing and relaxing.
